reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a major update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials sheet instead of a single cost chip. This new feature allows you to see all the materials required for your builds, including stored vs. required quantities, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change enhances your building experience by providing all the necessary information at a glance. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Provincia Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We’re thrilled to announce a new feature in Provincia! Build tiles now provide a materials sheet that clearly shows all required resources, making it easier to plan your constructions. This update replaces the previous single cost chip with a detailed overview, highlighting shortages and allowing you to manage your resources more effectively. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
